title: Kickforce

services.name: Kickforce Martial Arts
services.desc: Our whole family has been going to KickForce for almost a year now. The kids learn self control, structure, and confidence, in addition to self defense. The parents get a great, fun workout while learning martial arts. ALL the instructors are great. Pricing is reasonable especially for a whole family. If you're at all curious about martial arts, go take a class here (lots of opportunities for a free class). I joined KickForce as working remotely and sitting down a lot throughout the week, their weekly classes help me to keep my physical and mental wellbeing at peak. Second, I have found a martial arts school that prioritizes a great balance when working with individuals of various
